description: Design artifact, NOT a committed runtime contract. Canonical decision ledger for Action Clearance v0.1. Each decision references the companion doc that details it.
invariant: Action Clearance may preserve, narrow, defer, escalate, or block an existing authorization. It may never create authority, broaden authorization, replace ActionGate, dispatch execution, or own the authoritative consumption ledger.

naming.robotics_alias: NONE (no alias, re-export, or object identity with symbolu_robotics.autonomous_control_plane)

decisions.decision: clear-only; never mints authorization; robotics grant-minting NOT reused
clearance permissions SUBSET-OF authorized; effective_constraints = A INTERSECT C; conflict => ESCALATE/BLOCK; missing rule => fail closed
domain-neutral core + profiles; first profile github_exact_merge
new Clearance* family (ClearanceRequest/ClearanceResult/ClearanceReceipt/ClearanceStatus/ClearanceReasonCode/TrustedSignal) that CONSUMES the neutral ActionGovernance* seam via a projection
four statuses CLEAR/HOLD/BLOCK/ESCALATE; STALE/EXPIRED/INCOMPLETE/CONFLICT/UNTRUSTED are reason codes; DENY not used; precedence BLOCK>ESCALATE>HOLD>CLEAR
ClearanceResult = deterministic evaluator output; ClearanceReceipt = durable workflow record; storage metadata excluded from result_fingerprint
caller-supplied request_id + content-addressed result_id = 'acr_' + result_fingerprint; no core UUID/clock

caller-supplied evaluation_time; valid_until <= authorization.expires_at and <= min(required-signal valid_until) and <= evaluated_at+max_lifetime; strict expiry; skew != expiry; boundary-at-expiry = expired
canonical JSON + SHA-256 domain-separated fingerprints (action/request/signal_bundle/result); no random/clock/network/env/mutable-global/unordered-reason
core persists nothing; Workflow Service persists ClearanceReceipt; execution/idempotency ledger persists reservation/consumption/dispatch/observation

downstream execution/idempotency ledger; replay_key = (tenant, authorization_ref, action_fingerprint, target, operation); Action Clearance receives prior-consumption as a signal; race => atomic reservation, one wins other DUPLICATE
consume a minimal authorization projection + refs/fingerprints; only AUTHORIZED/AUTHORIZED_WITH_CONSTRAINTS eligible; denials never clearable; workflow layer invokes both
reference DecisionRecord id, cer_id, CER content_hash, policy_refs, actor basis, override/supersession by id/hash only; no SoD re-run; no DA import; no duplicate decision record
directly-invoked capability; NO new ProviderKind; adapters registered/resolved by product/workflow layer, not GPF
bind governed artifact (CG v0.2 sec 4.6); MVP direct+squash; rebase DEFERRED; merge-queue clears exact merge_group_sha in Phase I
narrowing-only, constrained typed extension interface (no open plugin); profiles add signal types, reason codes, identity fields, narrowing policy; may not add a status or broaden

packages/capabilities/action-clearance src-layout; recommended dep ugence-governance-contracts>=0.1.0 (stdlib-only leaf fallback); never upward on CG/robotics/console/execution/incident/identity/workflow/Model Selection/Hybrid LLM/DA

robotics = SEPARATE_CAPABILITY/NOT_A_SOURCE_MOVE/NO_COMPATIBILITY_ALIAS/LOCAL_FREEZE_UNCHANGED; console = BEHAVIORAL_REFERENCE/POTENTIAL_FUTURE_CONSUMER; acp_db = future profile; no runtime migration now
distribution 0.1.0; contract action_clearance.v1; no compatibility promise to robotics imports
